title: Slowly and Softly
lines: Tim went to the shed for his ball.
A big dog naps by that shed.
Tim went slowly. Tim went softly.
But his foot bumped a tin pan.
It fell loudly on the rocks.
The dog got up and looked at Tim.
Then it licked his hand kindly.

questions.ask: Why did Tim walk slowly and softly?
questions.listenFor: A big dog naps by the shed. Have them find that line.
His foot bumped a tin pan and it fell on the rocks.

questions.ask: Do you think Tim was scared of the dog at first? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any answer. Ask which words made them think so.
